reproFailure: Before the fix, 'keeps the new run on its own line, so the store stays readable' fails with HistoryContentError: history store line 1: invalid JSON. The issue's repro branch is gone from origin (empty git ls-remote), so the test was written from the issue body. It asserts through readAll, the failure the issue reports, rather than counting lines.
closingKeywordReason: The fix fully resolves the issue: pushRun is the only appender to the store, so no other writer keeps the assumption.
assumptions: The fix re-reads the store in pushRun rather than refactoring readAll to share its text: the file is at 295 of the 300-line perf ceiling and the refactor would cross it. pushRun already reads the whole store once per append, so this is a second O(n) read on a path that runs about once per CI run.
The separator and the record go in one appendFileSync call, so a crash between two writes cannot leave a separator with no record.
A store already corrupted by a glued line is out of scope: readAll still refuses it, and pushRun still throws before appending.
The canary-misfit route ledger makes the same newline assumption, but it is a different file with a different reader, so it is reported rather than changed.
